The Madhya Pradesh Youth Congress has suspended 60 office-bearers for missing the INDIA bloc’s November 1 ‘Vote Chori’ rally at Delhi’s Ramlila Maidan. Those suspended cite weddings, illness and family bereavements as reasons for their absence. Some leaders have questioned the action, saying they were not asked for explanations before suspension.
